Thanks for putting this together — it reads clearly and a lot of it matches what I pictured. But a few things I really expected are either missing or ruled out, and I'd want them sorted before we call this the baseline.

- **The app filling in the details for me.** When I paste a link, I don't want to type the title myself every time. I expect the app to go look at the page and pull in its title, a short description, the little site icon, and ideally a preview image — and then I can tweak those if I want. I noticed you've put "automatic metadata retrieval" as out of scope. That's actually one of the main reasons I want this instead of just a browser's bookmarks, so I'd like it back in.

- **"Read it later."** I want to be able to mark a link as something I still need to read, see just those unread ones on their own, and then mark one as read so it drops off that list. I don't see that anywhere. I do see "favorites" — that's fine to have, but it's not the same thing as the read-later list I'm describing, so I'd want the read-later behavior too.

- **Doing things to several at once.** When I'm tidying up, I'd like to select a bunch of bookmarks and, say, add a tag to all of them, or archive or delete them together — including "apply to everything currently showing" when I've filtered the list. Right now everything seems to be one-at-a-time.

- **Smarter searching.** Plain text search is good, but I'd also want to search by a tag specifically (something like typing the tag with a marker in front of it), and to combine terms — this tag and that word, or one tag or another. And when I start typing a tag on a bookmark, it should suggest tags I've already used so I don't make duplicates.

- **Saving a search I use a lot.** If I set up a search plus some tags I care about, I'd like to save that combination and come back to it later without rebuilding it.

- **Keeping a copy of the page.** I'd like the app to hold onto a snapshot of what the page looked like when I saved it, so if it changes or disappears later I can still see it.

- **A couple of smaller things:** being able to sort the list different ways (not just newest first), and a place to adjust basic display preferences.

I'm not asking for accounts, sharing, sync, or browser extensions — those can stay out. But the pieces above are core to how I'd actually use this. Could you fold them in and show me the updated version?
